note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate and the worker were recorded as unknown and only the soldier is described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to brown; antennae uniformly pale brown; mandibles dark brown with yellowish brown bases; pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum yellow with brown patches; body and legs cream yellow. Cephalic pilosity moderate, pilosity of body and legs denser. Body length 6.10–6.40 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, slightly longer than wide (head length to mandible bases 1.78–1.87, maximum width 1.55–1.65 mm, width/length index 0.829–0.90); sides narrowed anteriorly; width at mandible bases 1.00–1.03 mm, slightly less than two thirds of the maximum width (index 0.624–0.645). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segment 4 longer than segment 5. Postclypeus indistinctly delimited from the frons, with one long seta on each side; anteclypeus transparent, glabrous and trapezoidal. Labrum broadly ligulate, anterior margin rounded, with 2 pairs of setae on the margin and 3 or 4 pairs of slightly shorter setae on the ventral surface. Mandibles thick, robust and short, slightly longer than half the head length (length 1.03–1.10 mm, left mandible length/head length index 0.546–0.59). Left mandible with a prominent, pointed tooth at the apical third (tooth 0.30–0.35 mm from the apex, tooth distance/mandible length index 0.28–0.32); right mandible with a small tooth slightly below the apical third. Postmentum subrectangular, sides weakly convex, anterior margin straight (length 1.00–1.08, maximum width 0.58–0.60, anterior width 0.35–0.38 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.55–0.65, width 1.00–1.08 mm), anterior margin deeply incised medially, posterior margin weakly incurved; mesonotum narrower and metanotum wider, both with weakly incurved posterior margins.
